contract: design-contract.md: MOSIP blue/white account and workspace screens; dark face verification; existing flows retained.

accessibility.evidence: Widget checks cover keyboard submission, disabled busy actions, readable field labels, 200% text layout, long task labels, and existing reduced-motion verification behavior. Material controls retain focus and screen-reader semantics. Manual Android TalkBack and hardware keyboard testing remain untested.

responsive.evidence: Rendered all four surfaces at 390x844 and 1024x768; reviewed large-text home variants. Large-text tabs stack on narrow layouts, scrolling keeps content reachable, and tests assert navigation stays inside the viewport.

loading.evidence: Busy password submission shows progress and disables login, back and forgot-password actions; repeat keyboard submission is blocked by widget test.

empty.evidence: RegistrationTasks retains a synchronization action and renders an empty workflow placeholder; no task counts are fabricated. Widget test confirms synchronization remains actionable with an empty workflow list.

error.evidence: Existing signup validation, email fallback, and every liveness error state pass widget tests. Camera, image and engine errors have distinct retry guidance.

partial.evidence: Task cards omit unavailable timestamps; missing or invalid sync dates no longer throw during rendering, and absent labels receive a safe fallback. Invalid timestamp sentinel covered by widget test.

success.evidence: Signup demo creation returns its username; verification Continue returns true only from success, with workflow-specific copy.

permission.evidence: Camera denial prevents start and exposes settings when permanently denied. Verified by mock permission-channel widget test.
